description: Add IdentityProvider trait and ConnectionContext to kith-core/src/transport.rs. IdentityProvider is a supertrait of FederationTransport. identify_caller moves from FederationTransport to IdentityProvider, taking ConnectionContext instead of bare SocketAddr. ConnectionContext starts with peer_addr and optional peer_cert_der for future mTLS/TOFU support.
title: Define IdentityProvider trait and ConnectionContext
